docs.title: Aim
docs.text: mango4j is a general-purpose Java library that provides reusable utilities and tooling used across projects.

docs.title: Module documentation
docs.text:
• mango4j-collections - collection builders, map utilities, reconciliation, and caching.
  • mango4j-utils - general utilities (conformance, masking, dates, URLs, mapping, threading).
  • mango4j-reflection - cached reflection metadata and property accessors.
  • mango4j-validation - Jakarta validation helpers and reusable constraints.
  • mango4j-hibernate-proxy-resolver - Hibernate proxy resolver for mutators.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Common collections utilities for map/list construction, map operations, reconciliation, and caching.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
• Builders: MapBuilder and ListBuilder for fluent construction.
  • Utilities: MapUtils for merge/replace/copy and path creation.
  • Reconciliation: CollectionReconciler for current vs desired collections.
  • Caching: ConcurrentCache with TTL and eviction support.

docs.title: Build a map with specific implementation
Build a map and add items (nested)
docs.text:
Map<String, Object> map = MapBuilder.<String, Object>map()
    .with("first", "Tom")
    .with("last", "Cruise")
    .with("address",
        MapBuilder.<String, String>map()
            .with("line1", "One South County")
            .with("line2", "Leopardstown")
            .build()
    )
    .build();

docs.text: Fluent builder for lists, with optional concrete list implementations.

MapUtils
docs.text: Utilities for merging, replacing, copying, and list-wrapping map values.

docs.title: Wrap values in lists
docs.text:
Map<String, String> input = MapBuilder.<String, String>map()
    .with("name", "java")
    .build();

Map<String, List<String>> output = MapUtils.entriesToList(input);

docs.title: CollectionReconciler
docs.text:
Reconciles a current collection against a desired collection using a key extractor.

List<User> current = new ArrayList<>(List.of(new User("u1"), new User("u2")));
List<User> desired = List.of(new User("u2"), new User("u3"));

CollectionReconciler.reconcile(current, desired, User::id);

docs.title: ConcurrentCache
docs.text:
TTL-based cache with eviction and optional AutoCloseable cleanup.

ScheduledExecutorService cleaner = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
ConcurrentCache<String, String> cache = new ConcurrentCache<>(
    Duration.ofMinutes(10),
    Duration.ofMinutes(10),
    Duration.ofSeconds(5),
    Duration.ofMinutes(1),
    cleaner,
    Clock.systemUTC()
);

cache.put("token", "abc123");
String value = cache.get("token");

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Hibernate proxy resolver used with ObjectMutator to unwrap lazy proxies.

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
ObjectMutator mutator = new ObjectMutator(new HibernateProxyResolver())
    .on(Text.class, new HtmlEscapeMutator());

mutator.mutate(entity);

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Reflection helpers with cached metadata and property accessors.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
• ClassInfo caches fields and methods for faster reflection.
  • PropertyAccessor resolves getters/setters via conventions or annotations.
  • ReflectionUtils offers convenient get/set operations and method lookups.

docs.title: Manipulate a property using a PropertyAccessor
docs.text:
Profile profile = new Profile(...);
PropertyAccessor<String> accessor = new PropertyAccessor<>(Profile.class, "firstName");

accessor.set(profile, "Fred");
System.out.println(accessor.get(profile));

docs.title: Get a cached PropertyAccessor
docs.text:
Profile profile = new Profile(...);
PropertyAccessor<String> accessor = ReflectionUtils
    .getClassInfo(Profile.class)
    .getPropertyAccessor("firstName");

accessor.set(profile, "Fred");
System.out.println(accessor.get(profile));

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
• Conformance and mutation: ObjectMutator, Conformer, @Reduce, @Tolerate, @Text.
  • Masking: Masker implementations, MaskerFactory, MaskingUtils.
  • Date/time: DateUtils, CalendarUtils, Proximity, MovingClock.
  • Mapping: MappingUtils for object-to-map/JSON conversion.
  • URLs and formatting: URLGenerator, QueryParam, MapFormat.
  • Threading and entities: NamedScheduledExecutorBuilder, EntityToStringBuilder.

docs.title: Conformance with @Tolerate and @Reduce
docs.text:
class Category {
    @Tolerate(min = 3, max = 3)
    private String code;

    @Reduce(max = 5)
    private String label;
}

Category category = new Category();
category.setCode("SQL Database");
category.setLabel("Payments Platform");

Conformer.conform(category);

docs.title: ObjectMutator with HTML escaping
docs.text:
class Message {
    @Text
    private String body;
}

ObjectMutator mutator = new ObjectMutator()
    .on(Text.class, new HtmlEscapeMutator());

mutator.mutate(message);

docs.title: MappingUtils
docs.text:
Map<String, Object> payload = MappingUtils.fromObjectToMap(somePojo);
String json = MappingUtils.fromObjectToJson(somePojo);

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
• Constraint annotations: @Type4UUID, @StrictType4UUID, @IsValidKebabCase, @IsValidDottedCase.
  • Validators: KebabCaseValidator, DottedCaseValidator, IdentifierValidator.
  • ValidationUtils for programmatic validation and exception handling.

docs.title: Examples
docs.text:
class CreateRequest {
    @Type4UUID
    private String requestId;

    @IsValidKebabCase
    private String slug;
}

ValidationUtils.validate(request);
